Analysis runs at 22.05 kHz with mel f_min 30 Hz inside the upstream preprocessing; approximately 32 Hz low-string fundamentals sit at the edge of that front end and their contribution to the model's pulse is not measured. Real-take outputs are V6_private_real_take_derived and stay in ignored artifacts.

dependencies.note: A current verified denoised run or generated fixture is required. The gateway URL (VIDEO_UTILS_GUITAR_NOUL_GATEWAY) and the real-take switch are operator environment configuration; prior tools are not invoked automatically.

limitations: Gateway labels are opaque detector hypotheses (claim_class detector_hypothesis, authorship detector:guitar_noul, is_label false, user_reported false); they are never mapped to annotations, flags, review badges, user labels or counted as errors.
note_correctness and performance_issue are always null; no missed/extra-note, phrase or performance verdict follows from a label, and confidence_label is gateway-reported and uncalibrated.

The gateway is not deployed and the wire schema tin-5619-v0 and label vocabulary are provisional and unratified (gateway_wire_schema_ratified false, label_vocabulary_ratified false); until configured every call refuses gateway_not_configured.

Every run that is not a generated fixture with a recorded generator and seed is treated as a real take; its windows leave video-utils only with VIDEO_UTILS_GUITAR_NOUL_ALLOW_REAL_TAKE set to the exact V6 value, otherwise the call refuses real_take_not_permitted without contacting the gateway.

The client holds no credentials; tailnet/tsidp identity is assumed and not verified by the client. HTTP 401/403 maps to gateway_auth_refused and connection errors to gateway_unreachable after one retry.

Excerpts are 16 kHz mono PCM16 resamples of denoised.wav (<=30 s per window, <=8 MiB per request); approximately 32 Hz low-string content, saturated texture and the full custom tuning are not represented to the detector as recorded, and its behaviour on the distorted nine-string is unknown.
